summary: Rechecked the three requested records: study S1 and the all-participant and cross-condition nearest-neighbor diversity estimates. Read the complete 16-page markdown conversion, including all references; there is no appendix. Extracted the cited PDF text with pymupdf and inspected Figure 6 directly in memory. S1 correctly records individual randomization, an unstated experimental setting, 105 randomized participants (73 treatment, 32 control), and 101 analyzed conversation logs. The conflicting analyzed arm allocations in the results text and Figure 6 support retaining null arm counts; the two estimates also appropriately leave unconfirmed analysis-specific counts null. PDF p. 10 confirms the all-participant means (Treatment 0.33, Control 0.31; p=.02) and nearest-neighbor means (Treatment 0.20, Control 0.17; p<.01) for the recorded arms. Both script flags are false positives: the literal label "Welch p" is visibly printed above the middle and right comparisons in the embedded Figure 6 image, although absent from its PDF text layer. These labels support the recorded t-test type; test statistics and degrees of freedom remain null, and no figure-only numbers were entered. Confirmed across_people, diversity, embedding_similarity, participant unit and se_basis, more_diverse, AI available, immediate timing, null within_person, and ai_design. The five existing output contrasts cover all eligible reported outcomes and contrasts under extraction rules 4-6; no missing estimate was found.
